title: Homogeneous twist sections cut out standard opens on the invertibility locus
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring, $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ [def-pc-proj]. Fix $d\geq1$, and let $W_d\subseteq P$ be the largest open subscheme on which every $\mathcal O_P(nd)|_{W_d}$ is invertible and all multiplication maps $\mathcal O_P(nd)|_{W_d}\otimes\mathcal O_P(md)|_{W_d}\to\mathcal O_P((n+m)d)|_{W_d}$ are isomorphisms (equivalently, the union of standard opens $D_+(ab)$ with homogeneous $a,b$ and $\deg(a)=\deg(b)+d$). If $U\subseteq W_d$ is an open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion] and $f\in A_{nd}$ is homogeneous for some $n\geq1$, let $s_f\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U(nd))$ be the restriction of the canonical section. Then its nonvanishing locus is $U_{s_f}=U\cap D_+(f)$. As $f$ ranges over positive-degree homogeneous elements whose degrees are multiples of $d$ (and their positive powers), these loci form a basis of the topology of $U$; the affine such loci form an affine-open basis.

source.place: Tag 01MV (lemma-principal-open), with Tag 01MW (lemma-ample-on-proj), clauses (5)--(7), and Tag 01MS (lemma-where-invertible).

proof.text: Cover $U$ by $U\cap V$, where $V=D_+(ab)$, $\alpha=\deg a=\deg b+d=\beta+d$; these charts cover by the assumed union description of $W_d$. Apply [lem-trf-proj-product-chart-twist-frame] with the given $n,f$: the restricted twist has basis $e=(a/b)^n$ and $s_f=c e$, $c=b^nf/a^n$. Apply the stalk definition in [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] to the invertible module $\mathcal L=\mathcal O_U(nd)$ and its first tensor power. At $x\in U\cap V$ nonvanishing is $c_xe_x\notin\mathfrak m_x(\mathcal O_U(nd))_x$. The basis identifies this with $c_x\notin\mathfrak m_x$, equivalently $c_x$ is a unit of the local ring. Restriction to an open preserves this local ring and the displayed frame.

source.place: Tags 01MU (lemma-where-invertible), first proof paragraph, and 01MV (lemma-principal-open), coefficient in a local frame.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-proj-product-chart-coefficient-locus] on each such $V$, with $d,n\geq1$ and $\alpha=\beta+d$. It identifies the unit locus of precisely this coefficient $c$ with $V\cap D_+(f)$. The previous step therefore gives $U_{s_f}\cap V=U\cap V\cap D_+(f)$. For every point of $U$ some chart contains it, so these equalities imply $U_{s_f}=U\cap D_+(f)$. Empty charts contribute no points; zero or nilpotent $f$ gives the empty locus by the cited coefficient lemma.

source.place: Tag 01MV (lemma-principal-open), coefficient principal open and covering argument.

proof.text: Let $x\in U$ and let $N\subseteq U$ be an open neighbourhood of $x$. Since $U$ is open in $P$, $N$ is open in $P$ too. Apply [lem-trf-proj-degree-multiple-affine-refinement] with this $d$ to obtain $g\in A_q$, $q\geq1$, and $f=g^d\in A_{qd}$ with $x\in D_+(f)=D_+(g)\subseteq N$. The first clause just proved gives $U_{s_f}=U\cap D_+(f)=D_+(g)$, an affine open by that same refinement lemma. Thus every point and neighbourhood contain an affine member of the stated section-locus family. Every member is open by $U_{s_f}=U\cap D_+(f)$; this proves both basis assertions. This argument uses whole standard opens contained in $U$, and asserts no affineness of an arbitrary intersection $U\cap D_+(f)$. For empty $U$ the conditions are vacuous.

source.place: Tag 01MW (lemma-ample-on-proj), clauses (6)--(7), assembly after positive-power affine refinement.

lean.statement: theorem twistSectionBasicOpen (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (W : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (_hW : W = ⨆ (α : ℕ) (β : ℕ) (a : 𝒜 α) (b : 𝒜 β) (_ : α = β + d), basicOpen 𝒜 ((a : A) * (b : A))) (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (_hU : U ≤ W) : (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (f : A) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 (n * d)), Scheme.Modules.nonvanishingLocus ((twist 𝒜 (0 + ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ))).restrict U.ι) (twistSectionOnOpen 𝒜 U hf) = ((U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ basicOpen 𝒜 f : U.toScheme.Opens) : Set U.toScheme)) ∧ TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis (twistSectionLoci 𝒜 d U) ∧ TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis {V : Set U.toScheme | V ∈ twistSectionLoci 𝒜 d U ∧ ∃ O : U.toScheme.Opens, (O : Set U.toScheme) = V ∧ IsAffineOpen O}
lean.note: Uses the node's equivalent union characterization of W_d as the explicit equality hW; the two helper definitions construct the restricted canonical section and collect its actual stalk nonvanishing sets. No twisting sheaf, module restriction, or nonvanishing predicate is redefined.
